description: [Data utilities] Sanity-check a vendor's or sender's domain before trusting an email, link or payment request. Use when an unfamiliar domain appears in an invoice, email or supplier record. Price: $0.003 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/domain-check

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com (no scheme or path)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

name: domain_check
title: Domain Trust Check (DNS, Email Auth, TLS, Headers) ($0.003)
